problem: Which of the following regions is *not* connected?
worked_solution:
A region $D$ is connected if every pair of points in $D$ can be joined by a smooth curve or a path in $D.$ 

Among the given options, the only one that does not satisfy this definition is the following:

  

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14071672/assets/12c8be4491fe81d8ccf4ea964d883f2dc079f5183b72a8cd5b38260b8d3229d5.png)

Note that if we take two points $P$ and $Q$, as shown below, there is no path lying entirely within the region that connects them.

   

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture-workers/multivariable/14071672/assets/b3dd1c29d770f36e4542427175eab7e102ee3e43a944d525459d28257e6d24a7.png)
